originalTitle: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push

content: Meta says it’s issuing a new class of shares to fund its AI initiatives. As part of its third-quarter earnings report released on Wednesday, the company says the non-voting stock will also go toward potential acquisitions and employee compensation, with trading beginning in 2027. “The scale of investment required to compete, sustain growth, expand infrastructure, and pursue new strategic initiatives amidst the AI transformation taking place in the industry is significant,” Meta says in the press release. Susan Li, Meta’s chief financial officer, added during an earnings call that the new class of shares will “expand our funding tools and give us flexibility to invest behind the unprecedented momentum we’re seeing across every part of our business driven by AI.” Meta has poured billions of dollars into the AI race as it builds (and promotes) sprawling data centers, poaches top talent from other companies like OpenAI, and builds AI models capable of rivaling those from other tech giants. The company expects capital expenditures between $135 billion and $145 billion this year, up from the previous $130 billion and $145 billion estimate. It’s been a busy past few weeks for Meta, which launched its AI agent, Muse, in September. Like other AI agents, Muse can do things like clean out your email inbox, book restaurant reservations, and plan trips. The Muse app shot to the top of app stores shortly after its rollout, and hit 10 million downloads in the US this week. Meta also rolled out its Muse Wonder model this week. Muse’s launch hasn’t come without some snags. Amid concerns about user privacy, a tech YouTuber reported that the agent gave out his address to a stranger on Facebook Marketplace. The company has also had to pause Muse’s conversation-sharing feature after researchers discovered chats publicly available on the web.
chineseTitle: Meta 将创建新的股票类别来资助 AI 的发展

chineseContent: Meta 表示，它正在发行新类别的股票来为其人工智能计划提供资金。作为周三发布的第三季度收益报告的一部分，该公司表示，无投票权的股票还将用于潜在的收购和员工薪酬，交易将于 2027 年开始。“在行业正在进行的人工智能转型中，竞争、维持增长、扩大基础设施和追求新的战略举措所需的投资规模是巨大的，”Meta 在新闻稿中表示。 Meta 首席财务官 Susan Li 在财报电话会议上补充道，新类别的股票将“扩大我们的融资工具，让我们能够灵活地进行投资，以支持我们在人工智能驱动的业务各个领域所看到的前所未有的势头。” Meta 已向人工智能竞赛投入了数十亿美元，建立（并推广）庞大的数据中心，从 OpenAI 等其他公司挖来顶尖人才，并构建能够与其他科技巨头的人工智能模型相媲美的人工智能模型。该公司预计今年的资本支出将在 1350 亿美元至 1450 亿美元之间，高于之前预计的 1300 亿美元至 1450 亿美元。对于 Meta 来说，过去几周很忙碌，该公司于 9 月份推出了人工智能代理 Muse。与其他人工智能代理一样，Muse 可以执行诸如清理电子邮件收件箱、预订餐厅和计划旅行等操作。 Muse 应用程序推出后不久就登上了应用程序商店的榜首，本周在美国的下载量达到了 1000 万次。 Meta 本周还推出了 Muse Wonder 模型。 Muse 的推出也遇到了一些障碍。出于对用户隐私的担忧，一位科技 YouTuber 报道称，该代理人将他的地址泄露给了 Facebook Marketplace 上的一名陌生人。经过研究后，该公司还不得不暂停 Muse 的对话共享功能
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
